svg.title: Companion theme contract: definition, renderer and surfaces
svg.desc: OG leaves the UI kit untouched. Other definitions supply palette, backdrop and terminal colors. Optional immersive keys flow through companionThemeVars into a small set of dashboard surfaces. Sound, the 3D office, native Android and semantic state are not controlled by this contract.
svg.text: From theme definition to companion surface
Each selector requires its own key
Page, Thread, controls, menus and panes · OG keeps the kit
Wallpaper and ambient motion · terminal cursor, ink and selection
Titles and instrument captions · original typography otherwise
Header, team shell, empty card / pane corners · existing glass and radius
Floor, directory and pane headers, empty card · no registration rule by default
Mission Control and workspace icon surfaces · original badge and ink
Decorative nameplate in the sidebar and empty state · absent by default
Buttons, segments, filters, pills · existing face and corners otherwise
Keyboard focus and UI text selection · original indicators otherwise
Sidebar, worker directory, filters · original row states otherwise
Section dividers, menus, sheets and Settings · existing surfaces otherwise
UI scroll thumb and live hover/press · no signature motion in Still or Reduce
Motion preferences and shared view transitions stay in charge. No theme sound.
No changes to native Android, 3D desks or avatars, status colors, or ANSI output.
